title: Stage 2 — recursion schemes: fold/map/for_all over ADTs (registry + validator + generated Verus folds + fold_bound)

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: Build Stage 2 recursion schemes. 2b: NEW thermite-spec/src/schemes.rs registry (5 schemes fold/map/for_all/exists/traverse, mirroring combinators.rs) + validator scheme-call recognition (schemes::lookup in walk_call), the flat-step cage (in_scheme_step mode rejects a nested scheme/combinator in a step body), step arity/shape check, and SpecError::{NestedScheme,SchemeWrongArity,SchemeStepShape}. 2c: lower.rs emit_scheme_defs generates per-(ADT,scheme) Verus recursive spec fns (fold_<e>/for_all_<e>/<e>_len, decreases l, reusing the Stage-1 recursive-fold shape) + the fold_bound_<e> induction-discharged-once law; a scheme call lowers via lower_scheme_call to cite the generated fn with the step as a typed spec_fn ((x+acc) as nat for fold). DEC NUANCE resolved: the scheme-call instance body is NON-recursive so its spurious decreases is suppressed; the generated fold_<e> carries decreases l. forge/check.rs needs no change (reachable_adt_deps already weaves the enum; the lowerer materializes the scheme fns). Grounded with real verus --no-cheating: list_fold.th certifies L3, the fold_bound multiplier + grounded instance verify 0 errors, the premise-removed negative control fails.

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: SHIPPED + critic-clean (57d9727 schemes, de458b2 the #71 cert-identity fix). Recursion schemes: schemes.rs registry (fold/map/for_all/exists/traverse), validator scheme-recognition + flat-step cage (NestedScheme reject), generated per-(ADT,scheme) Verus folds (fold_E/for_all_E, decreases on the value) + the fold_bound_E induction-once law, scheme-call lowering (step as Verus spec_fn). Critic confirmed the MULTIPLIER GENUINE (instance cites the law, no fresh induction; negative control fails; law not assumed), generation FAITHFUL (for_all is a real conjunction-fold; distinct bodies per scheme), the cage rejects nested schemes, no cheat. Found+fixed #71 (cert-identity collision: item_subprogram's SpecFn arm included ALL spec_items -> byte-identical lowering -> proof-cache collision -> all served as len_list; fixed via reachable_spec_fn_deps isolating each). list_fold -> 4 distinct L3 certs. workspace 465 tests, 0 failed. Stage 2 complete.
